we study optimal transmission strategies under Quality of Service (QoS) constraints in a buffered, dynamic wireless network with multiple sources, where sources use an automatic retransmission request (ARQ) protocol to improve packet delivery.

we have shown how a network with multiple sources can be modeled as a Markov decision process with constraints, and how optimal transmission strategies can be found as the solution to a linear program.
